notes.text: The Temple roster lists Neḥunya as the well-digger; the discussion also describes his knowledge of underground water.
The Bavli says he dug and turned the wells and trenches over to the public. Heilprin specifies pilgrims.
The receiving entry names the same appointees and explicitly points back to Neḥunya.
Ḥanina ben Dosa announces her emergence at the third hour in this witness.
The Bavli parallel gives the same daughter and third-hour sequence.
Yehudah reports that Neḥunya testified before them concerning repetition of the test. Retain Heilprin’s compressed report.
The related checked Yerushalmi passage in Shekalim describes the son’s death from thirst, not the daughter episode. The exact implied daughter parallel remains unresolved.
